authoring.author: claude-opus-5.5 (house-types pilot lane)
authoring.note: Nassaukade 318-300, west side (Elandsgracht end), 1891-97 speculative rows. Authored with house types: 4 types (B stucco-cornice pair, C banded door-left, A banded mirrored, D stucco attic) cover 17 of 20 pands; 314, 304A and the corner 300 keep their own design. Rows are strip.jpg pixel rows (ground = row 922, 40 px/m) read on 1x/2x crops of the roofline band.

types.description: 1897 row 318-315: dark red brick, 3 axes over a souterrain and a bel-etage, centre balcony stack on consoles, white stucco top storey under a heavy dentil cornice, slate mansard; mirrored pairs share one wide dormer over their party wall

pair-dormer.note: one wide white dormer (two two-light windows round a pair of arched lights, pediment on top) straddles the party wall of each mirrored pair; each half is authored as a dormer against the party wall

stoop-door-right.note: arched door portal with a stoop on the right axis, two round-arched bel-etage windows, two souterrain windows in a granite plinth

rhythm.bays: 3 window axes; door axis at the party wall shared with the mirrored twin
rhythm.identicalBays: upper storeys: 3 identical axes, centre axis a French window with a console balcony on storeys 1-3
rhythm.windowsPerStorey: souterrain: 2 | bel-etage: 2 arched + door portal | 1: 3 | 2: 3 | 3: 3 | dormer half: 1-2
rhythm.symmetry: each house asymmetric (door at one end); pairs 318|317 and 316|315 mirror about their party wall
rhythm.groundFloor: residential: stoop to an arched door portal, two round-arched bel-etage windows, souterrain windows in a granite plinth
rhythm.roofline: heavy white dentil cornice over a white stucco top storey; slate mansard; one wide pedimented dormer per pair, straddling the party wall
schemaLimits: the pair dormer's pediment and arched centre lights are not modelled (two plain half dormers meet at the party wall)
ochre tile tympana over the storey-1/2 windows and the stucco top-storey entablature are not modelled
the granite souterrain plinth uses the stone colour of the stucco surrounds

evidence.citation: strip.jpg pands 1-4 (2024-11-29): identical bodies, doors 318 right / 317 left / 316 right / 315 left, dormers centred on the 318|317 and 316|315 party walls

notes: detect-house-types.ts (salvage lane) linked the four bodies at NCC >= 0.6, two of them mirrored
